title: The Paper Boat's Trip Home
sourceTitle: An original fictional story; the characters and plot are invented.

scenes.title: Setting Off
scenes.narration: A paper boat takes a letter across the river. The current pushes it toward a rock, and it's too scared to go on.
scenes.sourceQuote: A paper boat takes a letter across the river. The current pushes it toward a rock, and it's too scared to go on.

scenes.title: Two Kinds of Advice
scenes.narration: The reeds say go with the current, but the water weeds say go against it. The two answers are opposites, and the little boat can't decide.
scenes.sourceQuote: The reeds say go with the current, but the water weeds say go against it. The two answers are opposites, and the little boat can't decide.

scenes.title: Trying for Itself
scenes.narration: It studies the ripples first. It turns and slips past on slower water.
scenes.sourceQuote: It studies the ripples first. It turns and slips past on slower water.

scenes.title: The Other Bank
scenes.narration: The boat reaches the bank, and the letter is still dry. It learned to listen to advice, and to watch the water right beneath it. What would you look at first?
scenes.sourceQuote: The boat reaches the bank, and the letter is still dry. It learned to listen to advice, and to watch the water right beneath it. What would you look at first?
